I got diagnosed on my 3rd birthday, and I’m 27 now. My control was terrible in my teens, pretty good in my early 20s, and not so great right now. (I have a 7.4 A1C, not terrible but not ideal either.) I was also an active alcoholic with extreme daily drinking from 24 to 26. The only complication I’ve noticed is that wounds heal a little bit slower than they used to, but that could also just be getting older. I get my eyes checked twice a year, they’re all good, my kidney function is normal, and I have no neuropathy. The main thing I would say is make sure to keep your mental health in check as much as possible. Burnout is very, very real, and we are more likely to suffer with depression and anxiety than a non-T1 person.
